about: The 7b contract of the manuscript's D74 payloads (docs/PHASE7_SPEC.md §4.4): verse lines, the continuation guard and the positional link, the stray note, the paragraph menu's roles. Every file holds real output for the book built by `assembly/tests.py::trust_book` («كتاب الحواشي والشعر», five pages), after one run; `assembly/tests.py` checks the live output against these files (`NK_WRITE_TRUST_FIXTURES=1` rewrites them). Line ids are fixture ids: 1000 × page number + order + 1 (page 3's first line is 3001); block ids are `p` / `h` + the first line id, note ids `n` + the note's first line id; the book, run and time are blanked.

files.manuscript.json: `assembly.services.manuscript_payload` (GET api:manuscript): `document`, `warnings`, `stats`, `seams`, `version`, `reviewed`. Page 1: a heading and four verse paragraphs (`attrs.style = "verse"`, one per line: p1005–p1008). Page 2: a note (1) that does not end a sentence. Page 3: a note line without a marker on a page with an open call: the guard keeps it on its page, the positional link gives it the call «(1)» (warning `note_marker_missing`, `marker`). Page 4: a paragraph «(1) …» left at the end of the body while its call is open (`attrs.noteFor = "1"` on p4004, warning `stray_note` with `marker` and `actions`). Page 5: a reviewer's «حاشية» on a body line (the note n5004) and «محتوى» (`main`) on a footnote-region line (a body paragraph)
files.rendered.json: `assembly.render.fragment_context` of manuscript.json: the rendered verse block (`data-style="verse"`) and the rendered noteFor block (`data-note-for="1"`), the D74 warnings as `meta.warnings` gives them (`flat_warnings`: `marker`; `actions` on `stray_note`: {key: "footnote", label «جعلها حاشية», role, lineIds} posts api:manuscript_roles with {line_ids, role}; {key: "go", label «انتقال», blockId} moves to the block) and their side-panel groups («حواشٍ بلا علامة رُبطت بموضعها», «فقرات تبدأ بعلامة حاشية»)
files.block_roles.json: the paragraph menu «نوع الفقرة» (`assembly.services.BLOCK_ROLES`, D94): its choices in order with the digit that picks each, the label «حاشية للعلامة (n)» for a block with `noteFor`, the request and its refusals, the request on a text edited on the book page (`editedRequest`), and what each choice makes of the block on the next run
